grounded_lg_ch05.transcript: LG AC pe CH05 error aa raha hai
grounded_lg_ch05.error_meaning: Communication problem between the indoor and outdoor units
probable_causes: Faulty wiring or a loose connector
Problem with the main circuit board
If it appeared right after installation or relocation: loose connection or refrigerant leak from installation
grounded_lg_ch05.safety_alert: Koi bhi panel kholne ya taar chhune se pehle main MCB band karein.
steps: Breaker band karke 5 minute rukein, phir power chalu karein.
Indoor aur outdoor ke beech wiring aur connector dhilla to nahi, check karein.
Abhi install ya shift kiya hai to installer se baat karein.
Power cycle ke baad bhi error aaye to service ki zaroorat hai.
grounded_lg_ch05.spoken_summary: Pehle main MCB band karein. Phir breaker 5 minute band rakhein aur wiring aur connector check karein. Error wapas aaye to service karwayein.
grounded_lg_ch05.source: LG India - [LG Air Conditioner] Guide to Error Codes
